properties.name: Netcraft DDW Intelligence - High priority match

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: High-priority {{IntelligenceType}} match {{MatchUuid}} for {{DisplayValue}}. See custom details for group and acknowledgement.

properties.query:
NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where Priority == "high"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    MatchUuid,
    GroupUuid,
    Subject,
    IntelligenceType,
    DisplayValue,
    Priority,
    Acknowledged,
    TakedownEligible,
    MatchSource,
    Url,
    DdwUrl,
    Rule
properties.description:
Identifies Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches with Priority of high.
Uses NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest so the same MatchUuid alerts once per window.
